facts.subject: src/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow.c
facts.value: An HSD_Shadow owns an HSD_CObj camera, an HSD_TObj-backed image buffer, and a list of HSD_JObj casters. Separately, eye, interest, up, and subject-bound inputs are converted into HSD_ViewingRect bounds, which HSD_ShadowSetViewingRect applies to the shadow camera's perspective, frustum, or orthographic projection.

facts.subject: src/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow.c
facts.value: The subsystem renders only when at least one caster is registered. Caster insertion rejects nulls and duplicates and acquires a JObj reference; deletion releases that reference and can remove one caster or the whole list. Activation is idempotent, allocates the texture backing image on demand, and adds or removes the texture from the material system. Ending a render likewise ensures backing storage exists before copying the framebuffer and refreshing the projection matrix.
facts.reason: Distinguish draw, capture and activation conditions.
